<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex012012026-10-1403-40-03" status="unreviewed">dang po <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">sngon gyi slob dpon kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5550">shan+ti pa</rs> dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3712">seng bzang</rs></note> ni skad cig ma'i sbyor ba skye tshul ni gnyis ste | rim gyis skye ba dang | cig car gyis skye ba'o zhes 'dod do ||
de la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">kha cig</rs> na re skad cig ma'i sbyor ba dang po sa bdun pa na yod la | gnyis pa sa brgyad pa na yod la | gsum pa sa dgu' pa na yod la bzhi' pa sa bcu pa na yod do zhes <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsA ba</rs></note> 'dod do||</seg></TEI>
